sources.entry: MacYTDL - A macOS GUI front-end for the youtube-dl video downloader. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/section83/MacYTDL) ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]

summary.one_liner: MacYTDL is a macOS GUI front-end, written mostly in AppleScript, for the yt-dlp video downloader.
summary.what_it_does: MacYTDL wraps the yt-dlp command-line downloader in a Mac application with a main dialog for downloading single videos and playlists, batch downloads, and format selection. It can download and embed subtitles (including YouTube auto-generated captions), thumbnails and metadata, and can download or extract audio-only files in a chosen format. It installs and updates yt-dlp and FFmpeg itself, with optional Deno for YouTube, and can switch between stable and nightly yt-dlp builds. It keeps a separate log file per download, offers an optional macOS Service that sends the current selection, clipboard or browser URL to the app, and includes a built-in uninstaller that moves components to Trash.
use_cases: Download YouTube or other site videos on a Mac without using the command line
Grab entire playlists or batches of videos
Extract audio from videos as MP3 or other formats
Download videos with embedded subtitles or auto-generated captions
Download ABC iView episodes (Australia) with episode selection
Send a browser URL to a downloader via a macOS Service
how_to_run: Download and open the MacYTDL DMG file from the repository.
Drag MacYTDL to the Applications folder.
Open MacYTDL and click Yes when asked to install yt-dlp, FFmpeg and the preferences folder.
Provide administrator credentials when prompted and wait for installation to finish.
Use the main dialog to enter video URLs and download.
notable: GUI front-end for yt-dlp built for macOS rather than a command-line tool
Installs and updates yt-dlp and FFmpeg automatically
Code signed and notarized by the developer, with AppleScript code exportable for review in Script Editor
Parallel, sequential and multi-process download modes
Localised into Spanish, Italian, French and German (translations noted as out of date)
caveats: Requires macOS 10.10 or later; a future version is planned to require macOS 10.15+, and older systems have many limitations
Localisation is stated to be very out-of-date
Uses youtube-dl only on macOS up to Monterey 12.2.1, which the README says has not been updated since December 2021
